content.value: Represents the myriad of common denizens of the wastelands.
Wastelanders who take what they need by force.
Combat trained troops deployed in a wide range of roles.
A well trained and seasoned soldier deployed on difficult operations.
A combat trained Mech Pilot, such as a Union Salvager.
A veteran Mech Pilot, usually with Corpo training.
Humans twisted by Chimerium mutation.
The Chosen of the Mastermind. Fierce Chimerium enhanced warriors.
Forcibly cyber-converted Thatcher workers. They can toil in the bowels of the mining pits for up to 128 hours before needing M.I.L.K.

name: Super Android Soldier
actions: Broad Koch Submachine Gun (Super Android Soldier)

content.value: Chosen from the most loyal, ruthless, and daring of Thatcher Steel mercenaries to be cyber-grafted into the perfect defenders of the corpo.
Thatcher androids on cybernetic mounts, sent to crack worker skulls to enforce obedience and loyalty.
Sentient android skulls, grafted with repair tools to maintain the facility.
Thatcher's war minister, transformed into a faithful mechanical pitbull and tasked with guarding the precious M.I.L.K.

The giant head of an elderly man has been mounted on the wall, half-flesh, half-android. Both of his eyes are lasers, and his mouth is an autocannon. He overlooks the operations of the grafting chamber, and speaks in a grating metallic voice.
A sycophantic follower of the Iron Lady, even before conversion. He leads operations within the command hub.
Pet Skull Drones x2
Osborne has two Skull drones, Tony and Benn, under his control, once his political rivals.
Osborne's pet pig, Hogg. This was the fate of an executive who questioned the Iron Lady and was punished for his disobedience.
Once the lead of Thatcher Research & Development, his barely-sentient severed head mindlessly parrots birdwatching facts. (Skull Drone with +2 SP.)

A figure who introduces himself as Dr Mortimer Apis and explains that he and his wife Regina are trying to create a bio-reactor fuel that can be grown all over the wastes, providing free power to those that need it. Players will recognise him as a Holo-Companion, though Mortimer will not recognise this himself and will be offended at the suggestion.

Mortimer was in an accident while developing the mutated wildflowers and was badly injured. Regina managed to store his body in a makeshift stasis pod at the Reactor Core (Location 04.07); however, its power requirements mean almost all of the Hive's energy is being used to sustain him until Regina can find a cure.
Mortimer is a Holo-Companion and cannot be damaged. He has no combat statblock; the Pilots cannot affect him directly, only by reaching the stasis pod containing his real body.

The engineer who constructed the Hive. Hidden in the fog of the Reactor Core (Location 04.07), she pilots a Queen Bee Pattern Atlas — her custom Atlas with many arms hanging beneath it like legs and two large floodlights beaming through the smoke it releases.

Her primary goal is to keep her husband Mortimer's body alive so that she may one day be able to bring him back from the brink of death. If the Pilots can somehow heal Mortimer (Requires T5+ Med Bay or Auto Doctor System), she will happily provide them with fuel and any other resources they ask for. However, any attempt to divert power or take fuel will cause her to call on all her Killer Pattern Mazonas to attack the Pilots.
Regina has no separate pilot statblock; her combat presence is the Queen Bee Pattern Atlas she pilots, escorted by 4x Killer Pattern Mazona.

content.value: The leader of Skinless Jim's Scavengers, a four-pilot lance roaming the OPTICON arcology ruins. Looking to score, not afraid of a fight, but will cooperate for a payday.
Skinless Jim is a Trooper piloting a Thatcher Pattern Jackhammer. Use Trooper stats for his pilot actions.
